edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. It governs your forward steps. - RE shield-speed spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

notes: Two name errors corrected: her Q is Sigil of Malice (the page said 'Sigil of Silence', which is Fizz's), and Distortion was called her R in three fields — Distortion is her W, her R is Mimic. All seven phases[].side disagreed with content win[]; the sides are proposed as one atomic group to the win[] values, with no paired win[N] edit because win[] already holds the target values. The packet flags 'chart contradicts data: Karma wins only 44.3% but the chart gives Karma 5/7' — the shape is defensible (Karma owns 1-5, LeBlanc owns 6 through first item, which is where most of those games are decided), so I did not move the verdicts, only made the two layers agree. Ethereal Chains: Riot's text says the root lands if the target 'remains shackled for 1.5 seconds' but does not state what breaks the shackle, so I wrote only the 1.5-second delay and did not claim range or line-of-sight breaks it.
